common.errorBody: Check your connection and try again. Nothing you saved was lost.
common.notFoundBody: It may have been removed or updated with your latest plan.
common.disclaimer: Rafeqi gives general fitness guidance and is not medical advice.
common.saveFailed: Couldn't save. Check your connection and try again.
common.disclaimerShort: General fitness guidance, not medical advice.

auth.tagline: Your AI coach for training and Egyptian home food — built around your body, goals and injuries.
auth.heroTitle: Your companion for training and food.
auth.signupSub: Two minutes of questions, then your plan.
auth.consent: I'm 18 or older and I understand Rafeqi gives general guidance, not medical advice.
auth.forgotBody: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to set a new password.
auth.resetLaterTitle: Password reset by email is coming later
auth.resetLaterBody: For now, ask the person who runs Rafeqi to set a new password for you. Then log in with it and change it in Profile & settings.

errors.email: Enter a full email, like name@gmail.com
errors.invalid: That email and password don't match. Check them and try again, or reset your password.
errors.passwordRules: Use at least 8 characters with one number.
errors.emailTaken: There's already an account with this email. Log in instead.
errors.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.

onboarding.saveFailed: Couldn't save your answers. Check your connection and try again.

about.title: About you
about.intro: We use these to estimate your calorie needs.
about.adultsOnly: Rafeqi is for adults 18 and over.
about.under18: You need to be 18 or older to use Rafeqi.
about.waistHint: Measure at your belly button, relaxed.

goal.title: Your goal
goal.intro: Pick the one that matters most right now.
goal.paceHint: Steady is easiest to stick with — about 8 kg over 4 months.

sub.buildMuscle: Gain size with a small surplus
sub.recomp: Lose fat and build muscle slowly
sub.strength: Lift more on the main lifts

training.title: Your training
training.intro: So your program fits your week and your gym.
training.expPick: Pick one to continue: it sets your program and starting weights.

expHint.beginner: New to lifting or back after a long break.
expHint.advanced: 3+ years, comfortable with heavy compound lifts.

injuries.title: Any injuries?
injuries.intro: Tap anywhere that hurts or has been injured. We'll adjust your exercises around it.

health.title: Health check

q.heartCondition: Heart condition or chest pain on exertion
q.pregnancy: Pregnant or given birth in the last 6 months
q.exerciseMedication: Medication that affects exercise (e.g. blood pressure)

health.yesBody: Please check with your doctor before starting. Until then we'll keep your plan more conservative — lighter loads, lower effort targets and more rest.

food.title: Food & habits
food.intro: Your meals are built from Egyptian home food.

review.title: Check your answers
review.buildNote: Takes about a minute. You can change answers any time.
review.ramadanNote: During Ramadan your meals move to iftar and suhoor automatically.
review.changeLater: You can edit these later in Profile & settings.

injury.restrictions: Restrictions from a doctor or physio

generating.title: Building your plan, {name}
generating.body: This usually takes 30–90 seconds. Feel free to put your phone down — we'll keep going.
generating.private: Your plan is built privately on our own servers.
generating.errorBody: Your answers are saved. Nothing was lost — try again and we'll pick up where we stopped.

planReady.title: Here's your plan, {name}
planReady.sub: Built for {goal}, {days} training days a week, and your injuries.

dashboard.offline: Can't reach Rafeqi. Showing what we saved earlier.
dashboard.checkInDueSub: About 3 minutes · unlocks this week's review
dashboard.weightRange: Enter a weight between 30 and 300 kg
dashboard.weightFailed: Couldn't save. Check your connection and try again.
dashboard.noNotesBody: Your first review appears after your first weekly check-in.

workouts.deload: Week {week} is a lighter week to let your joints recover.
workouts.deloadNow: This is your lighter week: {sets} set fewer and effort {rpe} lower on every exercise, at the same weights, so your joints and muscles recover.
workouts.deloadCheckIn: This week is lighter because your check-in said training felt very hard.
workouts.rpeHelp: RPE = how hard a set feels. RPE 8 means you could do about 2 more reps.
workouts.detailsSoon: This session's exercises appear closer to the day.

reason.deload: Lighter week: same weight as last time
reason.dropWeight: −{kg} kg to get the reps back

workouts.startOnDay: You can start this workout on {day}.
workouts.moveIntro: Sessions for the same muscles keep a rest day between them.

moveWhy.tooClose: Too close to {name} on {day}: the same muscles need a rest day in between.

exercise.swappedIn: You swapped this in for {name}, from now on ({why}).
exercise.swapUndone: Swap undone. {name} is back in your program.

logger.struggled: I struggled on the last set
logger.finishHint: Anything you haven't logged counts as done as planned.
logger.pickEffort: Pick how hard it was to save the workout.
logger.painDown: Down from {prev} last time. Nice — we'll keep the current swaps for now.

nutrition.swapHint: Within 10% of this meal's calories and protein

groceries.copied: List copied — paste it into WhatsApp
groceries.packNote: Amounts are rounded up to common pack sizes. Buy them wherever you like.
groceries.emptyBody: You have everything on this list. Next week's list appears on Friday evening.
groceries.pantryIntro: Staples you keep at home. We leave these off your list until you run low.

injuries.stopRule: Stop and see a doctor or physiotherapist if you get sharp pain, swelling, numbness, or pain that keeps getting worse.

warning.title: Stop and see a doctor or physiotherapist
warning.body: You reported a warning sign in your {area}: sharp pain, swelling, numbness, or pain that keeps getting worse. This needs a professional to check, not a training plan.
warning.paused: Paused every exercise that loads this area
warning.kept: Kept other sessions, at lighter effort
warning.emergency: If pain is severe, spreads to your chest or arm, or you feel unwell, call 123 (ambulance).

checkIn.reviewTime: Your review takes about a minute to write.

body.title: Body
body.weight: This week's weight · morning, before eating
body.photosPrivate: Stored privately. Only you can see them.

injuries.title: Injuries
injuries.newPainHint: Tap the area. Nothing new? Skip it.
injuries.flagNote: A "yes" pauses affected exercises and asks you to see a doctor or physio.

nutrition.title: Nutrition
nutrition.adherence: How closely did you follow your meals?

life.title: Life this week
life.days: Days you can train next week

note.title: One last thing
note.label: Anything else your coach should know?

review.title: Week {week} review
review.writingBody: Usually 30–90 seconds. Your check-in is saved — you can close the app.
review.slowTitle: Your review is taking longer than usual
review.slowBody: Your check-in is saved and your plan stays the same until the review is ready.
review.emptyBody: Your first review appears after your first weekly check-in.

progress.noPhotos: Add photos in your weekly check-in to compare.
progress.noData: Not enough entries yet. Your chart appears here as you log.
progress.noLifts: Finish a workout and your strength shows here.

profile.regenerateNote: Uses your current answers. Your history and progress are kept.
profile.deleteNote: Permanently removes your answers, logs, photos and reviews.
profile.deleteConfirmBody: This can't be undone. Your account, plan, logs, photos and reviews will be removed.
profile.equipmentIntro: Untick anything your training place doesn't have. Your plan is rebuilt around it; your meals stay the same.
profile.equipmentSaved: Saved. Your plan now fits your equipment.

warmup.title: Warm-up
warmup.why: Warming up gets your joints and muscles ready, so the first sets feel better and safer.

cardio.title: Cardio
cardio.notYet: You can mark it done on {day}.

swap.title: Swap {name}
swap.why: Why do you want to swap it?
swap.none: Nothing else fits your equipment and injuries for this movement yet.

reasonHint.equipment: We'll leave it out of future plans too
reasonHint.cantDo: Too hard, or I don't know it

swap.scope: Just today, or from now on?
swap.alwaysHint: Your program changes for every week from now on. You can undo it from the exercise's page.
swap.painBody: Add it as an injury, so your whole plan avoids the movements that hurt and checks in on the pain.

why.title: Why this plan
why.linkSub: Every decision, the rule behind it and where it comes from
why.intro: Every number in your plan comes from a rule. Here is each decision: the answers it used, the rule in plain language, where the rule comes from, and the result.
why.backed: {x} of {y} rules from your books · {a} of {b} decisions
why.formulasNote: {n} of the decisions use a standard formula, shown with its original source.
why.backedNote: The rest use placeholder values, marked “Not yet from a book”, until the real values are taken from the books.
why.aiSlot: A short summary written for you will appear here.

ingredients.title: Ingredients

reasonHint.dislike: New plans will leave it out too
reasonHint.unavailable: Something similar can go in instead

ingredients.noReplacements: Nothing similar to put instead: it's simply left out.
ingredients.dislikeHint: Only this meal changes now, and new plans will leave it out.
ingredients.alwaysHint: Every meal this week that has it, and every new plan, leaves it out. You can undo it.
ingredients.updates: Your day's calories and protein and your grocery list update right away.
ingredients.essentialBody: Without it, it isn't {meal} any more. Swap the whole meal for another one that fits your day.
